notes.title: Ultimate: Steam Awards!
notes.notes:
Heyho everybody!
We hope you enjoy smashing those pesky zombies!

It's once again that time of the year! The autumn sale is in full swing and comes with its annual celebration of video games: The Steam Awards.

And that's where you come in.
We're proud of the work we put into  Zombie Rollerz and obviously feel that it is the best game ever developed - and if you only think the slightest bit alike, nominating us only makes perfect sense, right? 

These are the awards for which we feel most eligible:

[list]
[*] Best Game You Suck At
[*] Best Soundtrack
[*] Game of the Year
[*] Innovative Gameplay
[*] Outstanding Visual Style
[/list]


If you prefer to nominate us for other awards, that's great as well!
Thank you so much for your support and your help with nominating us for the Steam Awards!

Team Zing Games

notes.title: Пинбол во время чумы: Обзор Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes
notes.notes: Современная игровая индустрия уже давно находится в стадии своеобразного постмодернизма. Особенно это заметно в секторе инди, где разработчики берут какие-то основополагающие механики из игр прошлого и объединяют их в одном проекте. Мы уже видели всяческие симбиозы из шутеров и карточных игр или даже текстовых новелл с тактической боевой системой, а студия Zing Games решила поэкспериментировать с концепцией пинбола, совместив эту классическую аркаду с элементами tower defense и “рогаликов”. В результате такого эксперимента появилась Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes.

notes.title: Zombie Rollerz is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
Rollerz! Are you ready?!

Launch day is upon us! Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes - the crazy tower defense pinball game is OUT NOW on PC and Switch! The folks over at Zing Games have been working hard on delivering a stellar roguelike experience merged with pinball and tower defense and we at Daedalic Entertainment can’t wait for you to get your hands on it!

Check out the launch trailer jam-packed full of fast-paced pinball action: 

[previewyoutube=vvGu7EzcNH4;full]https://youtu.be/vvGu7EzcNH4[/previewyoutube]

In Zombie Rollerz: Pinball Heroes, you will need to explore four distinct regions in the randomly-generated overworld for hundreds of useful items and skills! With these perks and abilities, face off against hordes of whimsical cartoon zombies as well as towering bosses!

In this ingenious blend of pinball and tower defense, players will be joined by ten different heroes, each with their own wacky abilities, to tackle eleven epic bosses! You’ll need pinball precision to survive the world of Zombie Rollerz and become the ultimate Pinball Wizard!

notes.title: Patch v0.3.1a
notes.notes:
In this patch, we fixed some bugs and update some gameplay mechanics.

[h1]Gameplay[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add some new patterns to the level.
[*]Rework the extra mechanic of BallModifier MirrorBall.
[*]Rework the active use mechanic of PassiveSkill Fury.
[*]Optimize the generation of levels and patterns.
[*]Rewrite the formula for hero max hp.
[*]Adjust Hero Alien init attributes.
[*]Increase the min damage from the pinball drops between flippers.
[*]Decrease the base damage of the Alien Badge.
[*]Reduce hp requirement for the active use of Passive Skill Living Bomb.
[*]Tweak some zombie attributes.
[/list].
[h1]Bugfix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Work around the bug that device with touch support can not control with keyboard and mouse.
[*]Remove the debug function of loading animation.
[/list]
[h1]Graphic[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add vfx for the spawning of zombie heads.
[/list]
[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*]Add a tooltip to backpack item ui in keyboard mode.
[/list]

notes.title: Zombie Rollerz is holding a closed beta starting on 9/17/2018
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Thank you for signing up for our closed beta. Zombie Rollerz is an upcoming roguelike pinball game. You will crush countless amounts of zombies with your pinballs. 

We appreciate your participation and welcome all critical feedback and suggestions. Please note that Zombie Rollerz is still in an early development state. Bugs and crashes may occur during this beta test. Please kindly report them to us here. Thank you again for joining us to make this game better together!

If you don’t already have a steam key to join our closed beta, you can sign up through our [url=https://www.facebook.com/ZingGamesInc/] Facebook Page [/url]. However, at this point, we cannot guarantee that you will receive a steam key. 

Staff,
Zing Games
